name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden Thumb Page Spreader
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, offering a warm, elegant, and lightweight feel.
    - Features a 2-layer wooden construction for added depth, durability, and a refined decorative appearance.
    - Each wooden layer has a thickness of ~3mm, creating a sturdy and comfortable structure for everyday use.
    - Smooth surface and finely cut edges provide a polished finish and a comfortable grip while reading.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Layer 1 supports 2-sided printing for both front and back visibility.
    - Layer 2 supports 1-sided printing and enhances the overall design with decorative cutout details.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as a practical reading accessory and decorative bookmark tool.
    - Designed to help hold pages open comfortably with one hand while reading.
    - Fits around the thumb for easier page control and a more relaxed reading experience.
    - Lightweight and compact, making it easy to carry inside books, bags, or reading kits.
    - Perfect for novels, journals, planners, study books, and daily reading sessions.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for book lovers, students, teachers, writers, and family members.
    - Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, graduations, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for readers who enjoy unique, handcrafted, and functional accessories.
    - A thoughtful keepsake for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Christmas, and holiday gifting.
    - Great for book clubs, reading communities, and literary-themed gift collections.
    - Adds a warm, artistic, and personal touch to every reading moment 🎁 🎁🎁

  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
